blocks.arabic_text: زِدْنِيْ، قَالَ: اِيَّاكَ وَكَثْرَةَ الضِّحْكِ فَاِنَّهُ يُمِيْتُ الْقَلْبَ وَيَذْهَبُ بِنُوْرِ الْوَجْهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) narrates, “I came into the presence of the Prophet ﷺ and asked, “Ya Rasulallah, give me advice.” “Hold to silence much. (Do not speak anything without need) This (silence) drives away Shaytan and will be a help to you in the matters of Deen,” the Prophet ﷺ said. Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) said, “Advise me more.” “Avoid laughing much, for this habit makes the heart die and takes away the light of the face,” the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَنَسٍ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ لَقِيَ اَبَاذَرٍّ فَقَالَ: يَا اَبَاذَرٍّ! اَلَا اَدُلُّكَ عَلي خَصْلَتَيْنِ هُمَا اَخَفُّ عَلي الظَّهْرِ وَاَثْقَلُ فِي الْمِيْزَانِ مِنْ غَيْرِهِمَا؟ قَالَ: بَلي يَا رَسُوْلَ اللهِ، قَالَ: عَلَيْكَ بِحُسْنِ الْخُلُقِ وَطُوْلِ الصَّمْتِ وَالَّذِيْ نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ مَا عَمِلَ الْخَلَائِقُ بِمِثْلِهِمَا.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates, “Once the Prophet ﷺ met Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA). “O Abu Dharr! Shall I tell you of two habits that are very easy to practise and that make the scale which weighs good deeds heavier than other deeds?” the Prophet ﷺ asked. “Ya Rasulallah, do tell me,' Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) said. “Make good character and much silence your habit.
